title: SanitizedContext
description: The only shape of page-derived context allowed to cross the network boundary from the extension to the server. v1.1.0 (Phase 6): adds explicit privacy metadata so the server can know redaction occurred. The gate's own pattern checks (extension/src/privacy/egressGate.js) are a narrow, deterministic sanity net, not a substitute for real detection (Phase 7).

version.description: Schema version. Bump on any breaking change to this contract.

page_url_hash.description: A hash of the page URL, never the raw URL.

elements.description: Non-sensitive, structural UI elements only. No raw screenshots.

redacted.description: Whether this element's text has already been redacted upstream (Phase 7). Defaults to false if absent.

privacy.description: Required privacy metadata so the server can know redaction occurred, per docs/specs/privacy-contract.md.

visual_context_version.description: Identifies which version of the (not-yet-built) local detection/redaction pipeline produced this context. "none" is valid for content that never went through any pipeline.
